fuente.titulo: Pope Leo's postoperative recovery progressing well

titular: Pope Leo's recovery progressing well, Vatican says
bajada: Post-op blood tests and chest X-ray confirm normal healing after lung surgery
caption: The Holy See Press Office confirmed that Pope Leo XIV's postoperative recovery is progressing normally, after blood tests and a chest X-ray were carried out as scheduled following his surgery on Wednesday morning. Source: Vatican News, Oct 14, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet hospital corridor with soft natural light; a stethoscope and medical chart rest on a table in the upper right third, left and center space left open and calm.
